utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour. Case number IT-94-2-T, the Prosecutor versus Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Appearances for the Prosecution, Mr. Ryneveld.

utterances.speaker: MR. RYNEVELD
utterances.text: If it please the Court. Dirk Ryneveld for the Prosecution with my co-counsel, Mr. Dermot Groome and Daryl Mundis.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you. For the accused. Mr. Morrison.

utterances.speaker: MR. MORRISON
utterances.text: Your Honour, yes, Howard Morrison for the accused Dragan Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Nikolic, are you able to hear the proceedings in a language which you understand?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you. I'm going to raise the issues or some of the questions I have about the protective measures later when we can go into closed session. At this stage, the proceedings are held pursuant to Rule 65 bis. Mr. Morrison, are there any matters you wish to raise in accordance with that Rule?

utterances.speaker: MR. MORRISON
utterances.text: Your Honour, nothing specific. There's only one matter outside the ambit of the protective measures I wish to raise, but that's probably better raised in closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Ryneveld, have you got any matters that you want to raise under Rule 65 bis?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: All right. We'll go into closed session or private session. It doesn't really matter in this courtroom; it's like a shoebox anyway.
